name: How much does a full bathroom renovation cost in Berkeley or the East Bay?

mainEntity.name: How much does a full bathroom renovation cost in Berkeley or the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full bathroom renovation in Berkeley and the East Bay can vary significantly. Factors influencing cost include the size of the bathroom, the quality of materials chosen (e.g., standard vs. luxury fixtures), the extent of structural or plumbing changes, and labor costs. We provide detailed, transparent estimates after an initial consultation and assessment of your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a full bathroom renovation in Berkeley and the East Bay vary based on size, material choices, and the extent of work required.
